summary: Iteration 19 verified the 4-item batch: (1) admin JWT gating on all 4 /api/download/* endpoints, (2) QA artefact regeneration at backend startup, (3) new admin-only QA API (/api/qa/test-cases, /api/qa/results, /api/qa/summary), (4) /qa-tracker UI incl. RBAC route protection and Mongo persistence. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases passed (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration19.py). Frontend: all admin download buttons trigger real blob downloads with correct filenames; QA Tracker renders 35 rows, 5 stat cards, filters and search; status ticks persist to Mongo and counters/pass-rate update; executive is blocked from /qa-tracker and has no QA Tracker link. No defects found.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/qa.py: latest-run aggregation uses to_list(500) — with append-only qa_results this caps at 500 distinct test_ids (fine today at 35 cases) but consider an index on {test_id:1, run_at:-1} to keep the $sort+$group cheap as the collection grows.
qa_results is append-only with no pruning; a long-lived tracker will accumulate rows. Consider TTL or upsert-per-test_id if history is not needed.
seed_data_creation: Wrote qa_results run rows for TC001/TC002/TC003 during testing; each was returned to status 'Not Run' at the end so summary counters are back to a clean baseline (append-only history rows remain, which is by design).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: 4 download endpoints -> 401 unauth, 403 executive, 200 + correct content-type/file signature/content-disposition for admin. Startup log line '[STARTUP] Regenerated QA artefacts (PDF + XLSX)' present; PDF/XLSX exist under /app/downloads. QA API shape validated (count + 12 keys per case, no _id leak), invalid status -> 400, result POST reflected in /qa/test-cases and /qa/summary (pass_rate_pct recomputes). UI notes for future scripts: the 'Reset' button's testid is qa-tc-<ID>-set-not-run (label 'Reset', status 'Not Run'); stat cards are qa-stat-total / -pass-rate / -passed / -failed / -not-run; use page.expect_download() for admin download buttons (blob helper downloadAuthed).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no failures. The only initial script failure was my own wrong selector (qa-tc-TC001-set-reset instead of -set-not-run); corrected and re-run successfully.
